name: Skin editor help
description: Help mode entries (help@1) for the Token registry and the Skin editor.
author: Brett

entries.title: Skin editor
entries.text: Pick any UI and it is drawn in the sandbox with real components. Change a token on the right and the sandbox re-renders at once; every change is a snapshot you can go back to, and any state exports as a new skin.

entries.title: Token registry
entries.text: Every token in the system in one list: what element it styles, which area, state, light or dark, its level, what it does in plain words, its default and where it comes from. Search by any word; click a row to edit it in the Skin editor.

entries.title: UI to skin
entries.text: The screen, dialog, plugin or element the sandbox draws. Picking a new one starts its own snapshot chain at the default skin.

entries.title: Pick on screen
entries.text: Then click any screen in the console: it is loaded into the sandbox. Esc cancels.

entries.title: Pick element
entries.text: Then click a control inside the sandbox: the token list narrows to that element's tokens, so you edit the thing you clicked.

entries.title: Undo
entries.text: Back to the previous snapshot. The undo is itself a snapshot, so you can redo by reverting to the later one.

entries.title: Token registry
entries.text: Opens the registry page: every token in the system with what it styles and what it does.

entries.title: Level
entries.text: Basic shows the handful of tokens everyone changes, Pro adds per-element looks and transparencies, Advanced shows everything including layout, type scale, density and motion.

entries.title: Find a token
entries.text: Type words from a token's name, element or description to narrow the list.

entries.title: Revert
entries.text: Back to this snapshot's state. The revert is added as a new snapshot at the head, so the chain keeps every step.

entries.title: Export as a skin
entries.text: Saves the head snapshot's state as a new skin asset, starting from the console's look as it stands. Tokens a control set carries ride the skin as overrides; stylesheet variables are kept under the skin's own key.

entries.title: Skin name
entries.text: The new skin's name; its id is derived from it (lowercase, dashes).

entries.title: Skin description
entries.text: What the skin is for, shown in the skin picker.

entries.title: Skin editor settings
entries.text: Where the Skin editor keeps its snapshot chains and exported skins, and the last UI you picked.

entries.title: Open the Skin editor
entries.text: Opens the Skin editor, optionally on a UI or a token.

entries.title: Pick a UI to skin
entries.text: The next click anywhere in the console loads that screen into the Skin editor's sandbox.

entries.title: Open the token registry
entries.text: Browse and search every token in the system.

entries.title: Pick element
entries.text: Then click a control inside the sandbox: the token list narrows to that element's tokens.

entries.title: Every element
entries.text: Drops the element filter so the token list shows every element again.

entries.title: Export as a skin
entries.text: Saves the head snapshot's edits as a new skin asset with the name you gave.

entries.title: Sample button
entries.text: A sample control in the element gallery: it shows how the tokens look, it does nothing when pressed.

entries.title: Sample switch
entries.text: A sample switch in the element gallery: it shows how the tokens look and changes nothing.

entries.title: Sample segment
entries.text: A sample segmented control in the element gallery, for the look only.

entries.title: Sample segment
entries.text: A sample segmented control in the element gallery, for the look only.

entries.title: Sample segment
entries.text: A sample segmented control in the element gallery, for the look only.

entries.title: Sample link
entries.text: A sample link in the element gallery: it shows the link colour and goes nowhere.

entries.title: Area
entries.text: Narrow the registry to layout, style, colour or behaviour tokens.

entries.title: Element
entries.text: Narrow the registry to one element type: buttons, tabs, grids, dialogs and so on.

entries.title: State
entries.text: Narrow the registry to tokens for one interaction state: hover, selected, disabled and so on.

steps.say: Pick a UI from the list, or click Pick on screen and then any screen in the console. It is drawn here with real components.
Change a token on the right: the sandbox re-renders at once and the change is saved as a snapshot.
History shows the chain like disk snapshots. Click any one to go back; nothing is ever lost.
Export turns the current state into a new skin you can use anywhere.
Every token in the system, with what it styles and what it does in plain words.
Search by any word, narrow by level, area, element or state, and click a row to edit it in the Skin editor.
